public_rationale: OpenAI announced the completed financing on October 2, 2024. Its announced terms imply approximately $150.4 billion before the investment. That matches the rounded $150 billion valuation used in contemporaneous reporting and falls within the forecast window.
limitations: This supports the ordinary reading of a rounded pre-money valuation, not an exact $150 billion post-money valuation.
The announcement establishes the outcome but does not establish how much advance notice the forecast provided.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI will close its round at a $150B valuation within the next few weeks.

statement.excerpt: I hypothesize that OpenAI will successfully close its $150 billion round in the next few weeks, but that growth is already slowing, and will slow dramatically as we enter the new year.

our_interpretation: The dollar figure identifies the company's valuation in the discussed financing, not the amount raised.
Contemporaneous reporting described $150 billion as a pre-money valuation. I treat it as a rounded transaction estimate.
I interpret 'the next few weeks' as within four weeks, ending October 30, 2024. Closure on the publication date qualifies.
criteria.support_condition: The discussed financing closes between October 2 and October 30, 2024, at approximately $150 billion before the new investment.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The financing fails to close by that deadline, or closes at a materially different comparable valuation.

evidence.explanation: The company announced completion within the forecast window. Subtracting the announced investment from the post-money valuation implies approximately $150.4 billion pre-money, consistent with the rounded forecast.
